summary.intent: Prototype calling the tsrs dispatch without going through JSON text serialization, as part of work in the caliper project's semantic crate, delegated to a background subagent.
summary.outcome: The subagent had not finished: it was still waiting on its own background work and had not delivered a report. Files modified so far in the semantic crate are asked.rs, convert.rs and lib.rs, and the result is interim.

repo: The semantic crate (crates/semantic/src) holds the code involved: asked.rs, convert.rs and lib.rs were modified for the non-JSON tsrs dispatch prototype.
The subagent ran in an isolated git worktree at .claude/worktrees/agent-aa92cab9bf7fc5673 on branch worktree-agent-aa92cab9bf7fc5673, so its changes are separate from the main checkout.
workflow: A background subagent can stop with its own background work still running. Its task-notification result is then interim and a later SubagentHandback delivers the final report, so don't treat the first completion notice as final.
The prototype took 67 tool uses, about 190k tokens and about 22 minutes, which makes this kind of delegated experiment worth running in a worktree.

friction: The subagent's final report was not available, so the prototype's outcome (whether the non-JSON dispatch works or performs better) can't be judged from this transcript.
The transcript has no detail on the code changes, so there are no line-level findings.
